build_protobuf_package: build the protobuf compatibility test package by running python setup.py build
generate_proto_from_file: generate a _pb2.py file from a .proto source using the protoc compiler
run_custom_build_py: run the custom build_py command that generates proto files before building
install_protobuf_v250: install the protobuf v2.5.0 compatibility test package with python setup.py install
review_generate_proto_function: review the generate_proto function that invokes protoc to compile .proto files
